i.norm: Verifies that writing a full direct ByteBuffer to a truncated (empty) channel consumes all buffer bytes and reports the correct written byte count. Steps: 1. Create a fresh channel and truncate it to size 0 so the logical content is empty. 2. Allocate a direct ByteBuffer of 832 bytes (all bytes remain as "remaining"). 3. Write the buffer to the channel — the channel must accept all 832 bytes. 4. After the write, the buffer's position must equal 832 (all bytes consumed), and the return value must equal 832 (number of bytes written).
